expectations.schema: Exact Agent Plugins MCP 1.0.0, required mcpServers object, strict fields per server type.
expectations.transport: type selects stdio/streamable-http; SSE and unknown protocols are explicit per-server errors.
expectations.auth: Portable headers validate before client-owned headers are stripped. The separate Codex overlay only supplies local env_vars to existing stdio servers; no OAuth extension is invented.
expectations.runtime: Task 15 preserves unexpanded stdio cwd/env declarations and HTTP header metadata; runtime rejects unsupported settings until tasks 16/17 connect them. No service/process starts.
expectations.isolation: Package bytes unchanged; defaults optional, disabled packages absent, independent overlay cannot inject servers or change transports.
